about.intro: Experience artful, luxurious outdoor furniture at Ferrova Living and discover the true essence of exquisite design.
body: Ferrova Living is a premium outdoor furniture manufacturer that takes pride in crafting exquisite pieces that elevate the spaces they inhabit. We believe furniture should be a statement of individuality and personal style, made with weather-grade materials for hotels, resorts, villas and residences.
From the choice of finest materials to unique design elements, we work closely with our clients to create pieces that transform their space and endure every season, delivered across the country.
about.pageTitle: Made in Udaipur. Made for the world.
pageBody: Ferrova Living creates premium outdoor furniture at the meeting point of contemporary design and enduring Indian craftsmanship.
Every piece is hand-finished at our Udaipur workshop, built with powder-coated metal, teak and hand-woven rope to hold its line through sun, rain and humidity.

hero.intro: Premium outdoor furniture designed to bring comfort, character, and style to every space.

why.heading: Why Choose Us?
why.intro: By choosing us as your premium furniture manufacturer, you can expect superior quality, customization options, efficient delivery and installation, and a commitment to ensuring your satisfaction.

items.q: What materials do you use in your furniture?
items.a: We work with powder-coated metal, teak, hand-woven synthetic rope and performance outdoor fabrics chosen for durability and weather resistance.

items.q: Can I customize dimensions to fit my space?
items.a: Yes — every collection can be tailored in size, finish and upholstery to suit your project.

items.q: How long does it take to deliver made-to-order furniture?
items.a: Standard pieces ship in 3-4 weeks; fully custom orders typically take 6-8 weeks depending on scope.

items.q: Do you have weather-resistant outdoor furniture available?
items.a: All Ferrova collections are engineered for outdoor use, built to withstand sun, rain and humidity.

items.q: What distinguishes Ferrova Living from other manufacturers?
items.a: Every piece is hand-finished at our Udaipur workshop with a focus on longevity, considered design and made-to-measure comfort.
